findings.impact: Preferred URL signals are incomplete and links incur redirects.
findings.fix: Use final HTTPS URLs / and /products consistently in canonical tags, sitemap, schema and internal links, or explicitly configure an alternate stable routing policy.

findings.finding: No sitemap discovered; robots contains only comments.
findings.evidence: sitemap.txt: /sitemap.xml and two standard index filenames return 404; robots-raw.txt contains comment preamble only, no Sitemap directive.
findings.impact: A sitemap would provide an explicit discovery and canonical URL list. Its absence does not block indexing of this linked two-page site.
findings.fix: Publish valid XML with only the two public canonical URLs and advertise it in robots.txt. Keep admin out.

findings.finding: The homepage and collection reuse the same description.
findings.evidence: parse-home.txt and parse-products.txt: identical description beginning Discover family-made vetiver garlands.
findings.fix: Retain distinct titles and give the collection its own accurate product-focused description.

findings.finding: Social metadata is incomplete and shared between pages.
findings.evidence: social-home.txt and social-products.txt: relative og:image; missing og:url and twitter:card; collection shares homepage OG title.
findings.impact: Shared links may have incomplete or misleading previews; this is not an indexing blocker.
findings.fix: Use page-specific OG title/description/url, absolute image URLs and Twitter summary_large_image metadata.

findings.impact: Explicit machine-readable business and page identity is absent; no ranking or rich-result gain is guaranteed.
findings.fix: Add truthful Organization, WebSite and WebPage/CollectionPage JSON-LD matching visible content. Do not invent prices, ratings, registration or addresses.

findings.finding: HSTS was absent from the sampled HTTPS response.
findings.evidence: headers.txt: HTTPS and CSP, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy present; HSTS missing.
findings.impact: Security hardening opportunity; no SEO penalty demonstrated.
findings.fix: Review HSTS during security work after confirming host and subdomain HTTPS readiness; do not blindly add includeSubDomains or preload.

findings.finding: Core Web Vitals and performance scores remain unknown.
findings.evidence: pagespeed-mobile.txt: rate limited by Google API; performance_score=null, metrics={}.
findings.impact: There is no measurement supporting a pass or failure for LCP, INP or CLS.
findings.fix: Use a later authorized PageSpeed/Lighthouse run and Search Console/CrUX field data when available; no quota retry loop.

findings.evidence: llms.txt and routes.json: /llms.txt 404; robots has no explicit AI-agent rules.
findings.impact: Optional publishing choice; not a confirmed Google SEO issue or AI-citation blocker.
findings.fix: Prioritize crawlable accurate content and valid identity metadata. Choose crawler policy explicitly if the owner wants restrictions; llms.txt is optional.

findings.finding: Public pages are fetchable and admin has noindex.
findings.evidence: routes.json: final pages HTTP 200; parse-home/products meta_robots=null; parse-admin meta_robots=noindex,nofollow.
findings.impact: Public content can be fetched; admin communicates exclusion to supporting crawlers. Actual Google indexing is unverified.
findings.fix: Preserve admin noindex and exclude it from sitemap. Do not block crawling of admin solely with robots if relying on meta noindex; authentication is separate.

findings.finding: Both pages have unique titles, one H1 and meaningful static content.
findings.evidence: parse-home: 590 raw text words, H1 Rooted in nature; parse-products: 502 raw text words, H1 Our vetiver collection, 12 product headings.
findings.impact: Core content is present in source HTML. Raw parser counts include UI and are not quality scores.
findings.fix: Keep accurate product content in HTML; consider a more descriptive homepage heading while preserving design.

findings.finding: Hero and product images use WebP, explicit dimensions and descriptive alt text.
findings.evidence: parse-home hero: 1806x871; parse-products: 12 product WebP images with descriptive alt and 1200x1200 dimensions; later products lazy loaded.
findings.impact: These support accessible product descriptions and layout stability, though actual CLS is unmeasured.
findings.fix: Preserve these attributes. Review decorative versus informative craft images in rendered context before changing empty alt text.

findings.finding: The sampled public pages link together without a broken link.
findings.evidence: links.txt: one unique internal target checked, final status 200; internal-links.txt: two pages at depth 1.
findings.impact: The collection is discoverable from homepage links. This is not proof that every dynamic or external link works.
findings.fix: Normalize links to final URLs and recheck after deployment. Suppress script orphan heuristics: one incoming link is not an orphan.
